tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text:
Develop a retirement income plan using the client's stated retirement timing, spending goals, guaranteed income sources, portfolio resources, tax considerations, and liquidity needs. Document assumptions, identify planning gaps, and prepare a clear recommendation summary for review.

Prepare a retirement income roadmap for Julian Mossbutton and Elena Mossbutton that reflects Julian’s planned transition out of full‑time work at the end of 2027, Elena’s pension beginning at age 65, Social Security timing, cash reserves, and anticipated portfolio withdrawals, to be delivered by the due date.

subTasks.title: Gather retirement income inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending estimates, anticipated retirement date or phase-in plan, Social Security or pension information, expected withdrawals, cash reserves, and known large upcoming expenses.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and income scenarios
subTasks.text: Compare base, conservative, and flexible withdrawal scenarios. Note sequence-of-return risk, inflation assumptions, tax-sensitive account sequencing, and any years with unusual income or deductions.

subTasks.title: Identify tax-aware implementation steps
subTasks.text: Review opportunities for Roth conversions, capital gain harvesting, charitable giving strategies, estimated tax payments, and coordination with the client's CPA where appropriate.

subTasks.title: Prepare client review summary
subTasks.text: Summarize recommended income sources, withdrawal order, cash reserve target, key risks, open questions, and follow-up actions for the client meeting.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare that roadmap by 2024-04-26.
